assessments.rationale: CH-U001-001 presents the entire statement as factual. Its core concept is directly supported by SRC-U001-CLAIM-001 and SRC-U001-ANCHOR-001, and its strength remains within PLAN-U001's mechanistic ceiling. However, PLAN-U001 permits only documented specifics and identifies SRC-U001-ANCHOR-001 as the allowed anchor; that anchor and SRC-U001-MECHANISM-001 do not document the added trial, person, or date. Framing is not required under PLAN-U001.
